reuse.why: The change reuses tag parsing, sheet access, budget writes and undo wrappers, but copyPreviousMonth bypasses the category-selection helper introduced for the other month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Most category selection is consolidated, but copyPreviousMonth independently repeats the hidden, saved-template and fixed-group exclusion policy.

placement.why: Budget policy stays in server/budget/actions.ts, tag parsing uses the shared tags module, and method registration follows the existing app layer.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested month-wide actions, their registration, relevant tests and release notes.

maintainability.why: The helper improves ownership of most selection logic, but maintainers must still update two differently expressed implementations whenever the exclusion policy changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth implements eligibility locally instead of using getMonthActionCategories or a shared eligibility predicate.

disguised_duplication.where: packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts: copyPreviousMonth expresses as a JavaScript rejection condition the same exclusion policy that getMonthActionCategories expresses through SQL and a subsequent filter.

abstraction_drift.where: getMonthActionCategories gains includeHiddenCategories and its conditional hidden-filter exception, while copyPreviousMonth separately evolves its own exclusion condition.
